tourscope.title:
Tourscope

Travel Made Easier
tourscope.caption: Tourscope is a flagship product from Codescope, designed specifically for travel agencies to deliver a seamless booking experience for their clients. It features an intuitive design and lightning-fast performance that makes browsing flights, hotels, packages, and visa services effortless — giving travellers everything they need, quickly and easily.

hero.caption: The complete infrastructure to manage and grow your travel business — under your brand, and under your full control.

whyTourscope.title: Why Tourscope
whyTourscope.caption: Nine pillars that set Tourscope apart from traditional solutions in the travel sector. Each pillar is designed to give agencies deeper control, higher efficiency, and a real capacity to scale.

01.title: Full Brand Ownership
01.body: The platform is delivered under your brand: your domain, your identity, your interface. Your clients see a fully integrated digital platform bearing your name — not a third-party tool.

02.title: Centralised Booking System
02.body: A complete lifecycle from zero to confirmation: search ← pricing ← payment ← confirmation ← follow-up. An end to fragmentation and manual processing.

03.title: Advanced Pricing Control
03.body: Define pricing logic based on season, demand, service type, or customer segment. Real-time inventory and dynamic profit margins.

04.title: Integrated Travel Services
04.body: Flights, hotels, visas, tours, insurance, and eSIMs — in one experience with a consistent workflow.

07.title: Fully Automated Workflow
07.body: From booking confirmation to visa follow-up and supplier coordination — automated notifications reduce the operational burden.

08.title: Scalable Business Infrastructure
08.body: Add services, sub-agencies, or new suppliers — and multiply booking volume without rebuilding the system.

quote.body: Most solutions give you tools. Tourscope gives you infrastructure — a complete system to manage and scale your travel business from start to finish.

pricingPlans.title: Packages & Pricing
pricingPlans.caption: Three packages covering the full spectrum of travel agencies — from the specialist operator to the multi-market aggregator.

qualification.title: Two Extra Onboarding Weeks
qualification.description: Subscription and setup fees are due at signing, but the subscription period only begins after two dedicated weeks for training and data preparation.

minimum.title: 3-Month Minimum
minimum.description: Single monthly billing is not available. Annual is the default, and two years represents the maximum long-term savings.

charter.title: Charter
charter.details: For operators of chartered flights to Iran.

standard.title: Standard
standard.details: For full-service travel agencies in regional and global markets.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.details: For multi-market operators and agency network owners.

setup.title: Setup Fee Includes

items.branding: Visual brand identity design (Branding) and integration across the entire platform
items.domain: Custom domain deployment and SSL certificate binding
items.gds: Supplier credential configuration and GDS distribution system setup
items.training: Initial team training and database preparation

setup.footnote: Setup fees are not charged again upon renewal, and are not applied to add-on modules created later within the same subscription (apps and API are excluded).
